title: foreman
state_running_tip: The orchestrator is open and its loop runs.
state_silent_tip: The orchestrator is open but its loop does not run.
state_resting_tip: No orchestrator is open for this product.
soon: This screen comes in a later part of the new panel.
none_title: No product has the new panel
none_how: It is turned on per product, in its foreman.toml:
mean_worked: {mean} a day on average, days with work
g1_note: At Anthropic's API list price: it compares models; it is not what the subscription charges.
pick_one: Pick one product to see this.
confirm_grant: Let the orchestrator run the commands of «{group}» for {n} minutes?
grant_why_none: that request is no longer waiting (already approved or taken away)
grant_why_expired: that request is too old: let the orchestrator ask again
grant_why_session: the orchestrator that asked is no longer the one in charge: nothing was allowed
grant_why_process: the orchestrator that asked is not running any more: nothing was allowed
nothing_waits_hint: New questions and permissions will show up here, the most urgent first.
nothing_waits_short: New questions and permissions will show up here.
grant_why_short: Asked by {who}. Only done with your yes.
grant_why: {who} is asking. It only happens with your yes; if you do not answer, it expires and does not happen.
grant_orphan: Asked by an orchestrator that is no longer running: it cannot be approved, only discarded.
grant_not_told: The phone notice did not reach you
grant_say_push: {who} wants to push {what} to the remote «{to}»
grant_say_push_all: {who} wants to push the changes to the remote «{to}»
grant_say_release: {who} wants to publish version {what} on GitHub
grant_generic: {who} asks to run a command of «{group}»
answered: You answered «{answer}». The orchestrator has not read it yet.
answered_free: You answered in your own words: «{answer}». The orchestrator has not read it yet.
sent_not_saved: Your answer is sent; the orchestrator will settle it.
quota_none: Claude Code has not reported the quota yet
next_pass_due: The next pass is due now
st_lock: Waiting for its turn at a resource
watch_blocked: The browser blocked the window: open the link
cost_note: At the API's list price, to compare models; not what the subscription charges.
